text:
ada: Heads up — saw a sharp reconnect spike after yesterday's console rollout of the 'streaming.hysteresis' toggle. Surface: a bunch of tenants got repeated resume attempts that look like duplicate billing events.

sam: Ack. Do we have a quick repro? Any proxy logs or resume tokens?

ada: Attaching a trimmed example from the proxy logs: 
```
2026-03-15T18:12:03Z INFO resume_request tenant=tenant-42 route=eu-west id=abc123 token=tok-xx
2026-03-15T18:12:03Z WARN resume_duplicate token=tok-xx reason=early-reconnect
2026-03-15T18:12:04Z INFO route_swap tenant=tenant-42 new_route=fast-path
2026-03-15T18:12:04Z INFO resume_request tenant=tenant-42 route=fast-path id=abc123 token=tok-xx
```
Looks like the console changed the routing policy to prefer fast-path and immediately triggered resume on the same session.

matt: That log pattern matches what happens if hysteresis window is 0 or negative. The canary had a config diff: `grace_window_ms: 0` vs prod default `grace_window_ms: 2000`. Canary rollout was enabled by the console feature flag at 18:10 UTC.

karen: Oh — we intentionally set zero for aggressive failover during canary. But we forgot that resume idempotency is gated on the route_id being stable. If route flips within the window, we de-dupe; if not, we allow re-resume.

sam: Console telemetry also made this hard to triage: route_id and hysteresis_flag weren't getting surfaced on the stream SLO dashboard. The metric pipeline dropped route tags because of a shim in the console proxy.

lee: Filed a quick alerting rule: if resume_attempts_per_session > 3 in 1m then page oncall. But we need a short-term mitigation first.

ada: Mitigation proposal: rollback the console flag or set `grace_window_ms: 2000` for the canary cohort. I can push a hotfix to set grace window via runtime config.

matt: Also add a small server-side guard: ignore resume requests for the same session id within 1500ms unless token changed. Small delta safe and prevents double-billing. I'll draft a patch.

karen: Agree on both. For telemetry: I'll add a temporary tag injection in the proxy to ensure route_id and feature_flag are attached to the resume counter so we can backfill queries.

deploy-bot: Deployment scheduled: matt/patch/resume-debounce -> staging at 19:05 UTC, then canary at 19:20 UTC.

sam: Postmortem notes to include: console rollout UX needs an explicit checklist for route-affecting toggles, ensure telemetry tag coverage, and a runbook step to toggle grace window.

ada: One more note — customers hit duplicate charges because the billing pipeline uses resume_request events as billing signal. We should gate billing to require a final ACK from stream runtime. Filed bill-guard ticket: BLG-87.

lee: TL;DR: rollback/hard cap grace window, add debounce patch, fix telemetry tags, and ship billing guard. I'll coordinate on the runbook updates. :thumbsup:

sam: Thanks team — prioritize the debounce patch + telemetry. We can rollback flag if we see new spikes after the patch.
